title: Theme toggle with session and per-user persistence
iWant: my theme choice remembered wherever I use the application
soThat: I set it once and never think about it again

acceptanceCriteria.description: An explicit theme toggle is reachable from the shell on every route, operable by pointer and keyboard, with an accessible name and current-state exposure.
acceptanceCriteria.when: the toggle is located and operated by keyboard
acceptanceCriteria.then: the theme switches and the control announces its new state

acceptanceCriteria.description: Toggling applies instantly to the whole application without reload or flash of unstyled or mixed-theme content.
acceptanceCriteria.then: all visible surfaces switch in the same frame

acceptanceCriteria.description: The chosen theme persists for the session: navigation and reload within the session keep the choice.
acceptanceCriteria.when: the page is reloaded in the same session
acceptanceCriteria.then: the chosen theme renders from first paint

acceptanceCriteria.description: For signed-in users the choice persists to the user profile and follows the user to another browser after sign-in.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a signed-in user who chose dark
acceptanceCriteria.when: they sign in on another browser
acceptanceCriteria.then: dark renders once their profile loads, without re-toggling

acceptanceCriteria.description: An explicit user choice outranks the OS preference until the user clears or changes it.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a user who explicitly chose light on a dark-preference OS
